objectives.title: Into the Fire
objectives.description: Any of your characters reaches Mount Doom. Decisive: wins the war at once.

objectives.title: The White City Stands
objectives.description: Minas Tirith is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The Last Homely House
objectives.description: Imladris is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

objectives.title: Rally the West
objectives.description: Your own realm holds 5 or more PCs when the Age ends.

milestones.title: Gather the Company
milestones.how: Walk a character to the home of a Free Peoples hero — their character card is offered there — and recruit them.

milestones.title: Ears in Every Inn
milestones.how: With an emissary at one of your own PCs, Sell goods you have spare; Hear Stories there to learn what the Enemy is about.

milestones.title: Relics of the Elder Days
milestones.how: Take a mage where an artifact lies (Scry Artifact shows where) and play Find Artifact.

milestones.title: Counsel of the Wise
milestones.how: Keep your characters busy: every action they play has a chance to raise the skill it uses.

milestones.title: Friends in Every Hall
milestones.how: Found a new PC from a PC card in your hand, or bring a host to a Shadow-held PC and play Siege.

milestones.title: The West Answers
milestones.how: Play an army card with a commander at one of your PCs to raise a new host.

objectives.title: Master of the West
objectives.description: Hold Edoras and Minas Tirith at the same time. Decisive: wins the war at once.

objectives.title: Lord of the Mark
objectives.description: You hold Edoras when the Age ends.

objectives.title: Orthanc Unbroken
objectives.description: You hold Orthanc when the Age ends.

objectives.title: Industry of Isengard
objectives.description: Your own realm holds 6 or more PCs when the Age ends.

milestones.title: Fighting Uruk-hai
milestones.how: Play an army card with a commander at Orthanc or another of your PCs.

milestones.title: The Furnaces of Isengard
milestones.how: Have emissaries Sell iron, timber and steel at your own PCs, and send agents to Steal Gold from rival PCs.

milestones.title: Ten Thousand Strong
milestones.how: Keep playing army cards at your PCs to add troops to your hosts — and keep them alive.

milestones.title: The Voice of Saruman
milestones.how: Found a new PC from a PC card, or bring a host to a rival PC and play Siege; emissaries can Decrease Loyalty there first.

milestones.title: Wheels and Engines
milestones.how: Every PC you add produces goods each turn: found new ones from PC cards or take them by force.

milestones.title: Crebain and Spies
milestones.how: Use your agents and emissaries often: every action has a chance to raise the skill it uses.

objectives.title: The White City Falls
objectives.description: Minas Tirith is held by the Dark Servants. Decisive: wins the war at once.

objectives.title: Osgiliath Burns
objectives.description: Osgiliath is held by the Dark Servants when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The Dark Tower Stands
objectives.description: You hold Barad-dur when the Age ends.

objectives.title: Darkness Spreads
objectives.description: Your own realm holds 6 or more PCs when the Age ends.

milestones.title: The Host of Mordor
milestones.how: Play an army card with a commander at one of your PCs to raise another host.

milestones.title: An Iron Grip
milestones.how: With an emissary at one of your own PCs, play Increase Fortifications.

milestones.title: Tribute of the East
milestones.how: Send agents to Steal Gold at enemy PCs; have emissaries Sell surplus goods at your own.

milestones.title: The Black Gate Opens
milestones.how: Keep playing army cards at your PCs to swell your hosts, and don't throw them away.

milestones.title: The Shadow Spreads
milestones.how: March a host to an enemy PC and play Siege; emissaries can Decrease Loyalty there first to weaken it.

milestones.title: The Nine Abroad
milestones.how: Keep your servants acting: every action has a chance to raise the skill it uses.
